caribbean.headline: Bimini Faces Heavy Rain, Moderate Winds Today
caribbean.paragraph: Bimini is experiencing 25 kt winds, 1.8 ft waves, 6 s swell period from the east, and a 62% rain probability. I note San Juan sees 14 kt winds.

mediterranean.headline: Istanbul Faces Moderate Winds, Heavy Rain
mediterranean.paragraph: Istanbul is experiencing 15 kt winds, 1.1 ft waves, NNW swell with a 3 s period, and 75% rain probability. Mykonos sees 23 kt winds, modest waves, and lower swell.
